Description:
With fire in her eyes and a voice filled with righteous fury, she delivers her solemn oath: "I shall track you relentlessly, across every treacherous terrain and into the depths of the darkest abyss. I will not rest until justice is served and my fallen sistren find peace in their eternal slumber. Your deeds have brought forth an indelible wound, and it is upon my shoulders to mend it." Such is the way of the giant race, a fiercely independent and honor-bound people. Living within tightly-knit clans, they forge a society founded on principles of loyalty, strength, and an unwavering connection to the natural world. Gifted with a deep understanding of the spirits and the harmony of nature, giants possess a wisdom that belies their imposing presence. They are not mere brutes, for they navigate the delicate balance between tribal existence and an acute awareness of the world's workings.
Every misstep, every broken promise, echoes through the giant's being, weighing heavily upon their conscience. They are a race of sensibility, feeling every wound inflicted upon their honor to the very core of their being. The personal nature of their emotions often drives them to experience overwhelming grief, burning anger, or an unyielding sense of duty. Their autonomous societies thrive on self-sufficiency, and the giants take great pride in constructing their own homes and procuring their sustenance. Even in the harshest circumstances, where other races might turn to others for aid, the giants would sooner resort to pillaging and theft, for they view raiding as a form of labor rewarded by the spoils obtained.
However, among the giant tribes, there are those who break free from the chains of tradition and venture beyond the borders of their homelands. These individuals perceive a broader understanding of the world and its intricate mechanisms. Guided by a thirst for knowledge and the yearning to chart their own destiny, they set foot upon distant lands as intrepid adventurers.
Language: You speak Common and a number of chosen languages equal to your Intelligence or Charisma, whichever is higher, of which one must be Tribal Gian, a dialect of several tribal languages akin to Orcish or Goblan.

~Apex of Evolution~.Effect: Your starting Stats distribution is -2, -2, 3, 3, 3 (instead of -1, 0, 1, 2, 3).

Starting Abilities Description.Big and Strong: It's no secret that Giants are the kings of the hill when it comes to physical dominance: most are immense and have the strength of multiple smaller folk. But their size is not everything, and it usually comes with broad disadvantages.

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, manually reduce your Max Health and increase your Health Regen.

~Trollskin~.Effect:
Your Max Health is always 50% of what it should be, but your Health Regen is doubled.
You have -1 Persuasion and +1 Intimidation.
~Trollskin~.Upgrade: Your skin is akin to a troll's skin - rough and prone to blisters or acne, but regenerates much quicker than normal.

Combat Extras: Switch any Stat on Abilities/weapons to Might
~Greenskin Strength~.Effect: In weapons or Abilities, you can switch any one Stat written on it to ^Might^.
~Greenskin Strength~.Upgrade: Your skin is a shade of green due to the stronger hormones and pigment flowing through your body, making your emotions more difficult to control.

~True Giant Ancestry~.Effect:
You have +4 Max Health, but -1 Charisma.
You are Large, immune to Hard Terrain, and occupy a 2x2 meter area.
You have -2 Stealth and +2 in Lifting, which can exceed the Skill bonus limit.
~True Giant Ancestry~.Downside:
Body and legs armor must be fitted on you by paying 50% of its original cost.
You wear belts as bracers, bracers as rings, and rings as earrings.

~Cyclopian Eye~.Effect: Your first attack every Turn ignores Cover (if there is Cover).

Combat Extras: You can eat rocks, dirt and bark
~Ogre Fat Tissue~.Effect:
You are immune to being Slammed and to Falling Damage. When you are Slammed in melee range, you can also Slam the attacker 2 meters back.
Most of your meals can consist of rocks, dirt and bark.
You have +2 in Survival.
~Ogre Fat Tissue~.Upgrade: As an ogre-blood who can metabolize various debris, fat tissue is important to you not only for social status, but also for survivability!

~Ettin Crests~.Effect: When you take 10 or more Damage from a melee attack, Single-Stun the attacker.

~Stone Skin~.Effect: While unarmored, You take -50% Slash Damage instead of having +1 Movement Speed.

~Two Heads~.Effect:
If your class's Mana is _standard_ or none, you have 1 extra Mana, but -1 Sense.
You have +2 in Observing Detail.
You may interrupt your Turn, and continue it later after one Enemy acts (or at the end of Round).
~Two Heads~.Upgrade: Having 2 heads often means having 2 opposite personalities with different skills, 2 mental headspaces and 2 names, but folklore says 2-headed giants have only one soul, as they have one body, one heart. Life as a two-header is tough, facing likely ridicule or ostracization. But chins up! Two heads think better than one, and contrary to popular belief, such giants seem to have even more thorough control over their body!
